studio.referenceVideo.templatePrompt:
Use <Video 1> as the reference for the scene, shot sequence, camera movement, editing rhythm, lighting and composition. Adapt timing to the selected output duration; preserve meaningful cuts or continuous-shot structure.

If reference images are provided, use <Picture 1> as the primary subject and additional images as supporting references. Preserve the subject’s identity, shape, proportions, materials, colors and existing markings. Replace the video’s corresponding subject instead of adding a duplicate. Do not carry over the image background or static composition.

Adapt actions, interactions and details to the new subject so they remain physically plausible and consistent across shots. Without reference images, create a new variation based on <Video 1>. Do not introduce unrelated logos, watermarks, captions or unsupported advertising claims. Follow any explicit user instructions.
